liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Reviewer hears the melody of the folk song Goober Peas begin in the first track around 0:57 [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Indecipherable talking over pa//**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **jam, nothing recognisable as a tune. Mostly Phil and Billy (1)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **possibly part of a soundcheck (2)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **jam, similar to track 2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **jam, similar to track 2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Phil bass jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1966-06-01.136658.sbd.sirmick.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 6 songs; 25 min [1]
- **gd1966-06-01.136657.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: soundboard; 2 songs; 9 min; rated 1/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer enjoys the echo and reverb, which they take as typical of the early Dead; On the second take a rhythm guitar and third vocalist are clearly audible; reviewer reasons it must be Weir, since there was no overdubbing [4][5]
- **gd1966-06-01.136642.watts.sbd.mr.dat48k.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 2 songs; 11 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the second track is titled Wondering Man and wonders whether a third vocal can be heard [4]
- Garcia is heard saying he's tired of playing in a warehouse, and that it doesn't matter as long as people jump around [1]
- Notes say the third Acid Test was the 21-23 January Trips Festival at Longshoreman's Hall, San Francisco, so the reel label conflicts with this date [1]
- Described as a practice session featuring Jerry and Phil, with the song unidentified [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1966-06-01.136658.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SirMick; source: sbd > 10 inch Master Reels @ 15 ips 1/2 track > Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Provided by an anonymous source; the reel is labelled as the third Acid Test of 1966 [1]
- **gd1966-06-01.136657.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SirMick; source: sbd > 10 inch Master Reels @1 5ips 1/2 track > dat(48k) [2]. Also: Provided by an anonymous source; 60Hz hum was reduced and levels adjusted [2]
- **gd1966-06-01.136642.watts.sbd.mr.dat48k.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SirMick; source: sbd > 10 inch Master Reels @1 5ips 1/2 track > dat(48k) [3]
